name: s13-unpack
title: Extended unpacking
spec: Top code chip: first, *middle, last = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. Below the list drawn as five cells 1 2 3 4 5 with colored brackets mapping: cell 1 to first = 1, cells 2 3 4 to middle = [2, 3, 4] (green, the star collects the rest as a list), cell 5 to last = 5.
cap: A starred target collects whatever the other targets did not take, as a list.

name: s13-zip
title: Parallel traversal with zip
spec: Left: two lists, names ['a', 'b', 'c'] and nums [1, 2, 3], as rows of cells. Middle: arrow labelled zip(names, nums). Right: a row of pairs ('a', 1) ('b', 2) ('c', 3). Orange note: zip stops at the shortest input. Green chip: for n, v in zip(names, nums).
cap: zip walks several sequences in step and stops at the shortest one.

name: s13-loopelse
title: The loop else clause
spec: A flowchart of a for loop. Box for item in items, diamond break reached?. Yes arrow to box leave the loop, else block skipped (orange). No arrow loops back until the items run out, then to the else block runs (green). Caption: else means no break happened.
cap: The else block of a loop runs only when the loop ends without hitting break.
